Order help

Shipping & returns.

Fulfilment is not connected, so no delivery promise, shipping fee or return window is represented as active.

Before orders open

The operator must confirm serviceable locations, dispatch timing, carriers, fees, tax handling and support contact details.

Returns framework

A final policy should distinguish unopened ingestible products, opened personal-care products, damaged goods, incorrect items and non-returnable hygiene items. Customer rights under applicable law must be preserved.

Damaged or incorrect items

When fulfilment opens, customers should retain the outer package and product and contact the verified support channel with an order reference and photographs.

Current bag

Your bag is saved only on this device. It is not an order and does not reserve stock.
